integrity: Analytical proof supplied; numerical checker is corroborative, not proof of infinite quantifiers. No independent audit or experimental validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Ideal adjacency hopping, exactly two site-local absorbers with positive rates; asymptotic absorption rather than finite-time hitting, arbitrary onsite potentials or additional dephasing. Possible implicit overlap in graph controllability literature requires independent assessment.
title: Two-site absorption on Boolean hypercubes: antipodal spectral redundancy and exact site probabilities
